name: CarbonLens
description: CarbonLens is a smart, interactive carbon footprint analyzer that helps you understand your environmental impact and take meaningful action. Powered by AI and beautiful visualizations. Track. Understand. Reduce. 🌱

paragraphs: CarbonLens is a smart, interactive carbon-footprint analysis platform that helps users understand their environmental impact and take meaningful actions to reduce it. Designed with visual dashboards, AI-generated recommendations, and a story-driven user experience, CarbonLens makes climate action simple, personal, and actionable.
CarbonLens turns climate awareness into daily action. Instead of overwhelming users with charts, it:
It isn't just a calculator — it's a platform to help people live greener lives.
features: Calculate total CO₂ emissions (kg/month) from simple lifestyle inputs
Trend forecast for the next 6 months
Beautiful Streamlit dashboard with donut charts and trend graphs
